$comment: The employment record for every agent the harness can dispatch (.claude/agents/*.md). DR-016. Tier and write capability are DERIVED from each agent's own `tools:` frontmatter by scripts/check-agent-roster.mjs, not trusted from this file — an agent that lists Write or Edit can write, whatever it says here. What this file supplies is the part that cannot be derived: the write BOUNDARY, which must be disjoint from every other writing agent's. Vendored agents are byte-identical to third_party/everything-claude-code/agents/ and are never edited; their governance lives here instead, which is how a third-party definition gets a first-party boundary without modifying it.

tiers.0: Doctrine. DR-015's accuracy rules. Binding on every agent; owns no surface.
tiers.1: Owning roles (Core, Native, Reviewer, Scribe) defined in docs/agent/ORG.md. Broad write scope, human-sequenced.
tiers.2: Narrow specialists. One declared, disjoint write surface each.
tiers.3: Read-only reviewers and evaluators. No write tools, so they cannot collide with anyone.

agents.charter: System design, scalability and technical decision-making. Advises; writes nothing.
Decomposes work into ordered plans. Advises; writes nothing.
Adversarial correctness review. Reports findings; fixes nothing, per the Reviewer boundary in ORG.md.
Auth seams, injection, secret handling, supply chain. Reports only.

Keeps prose matching what shipped. Bounded to docs/ so it can never edit the code its claims describe. LOCAL CORRECTION (2026-09-02) to the vendored definition, which is byte-identical to third_party/everything-claude-code/agents/doc-updater.md and must NOT be edited: its "Analysis Commands" block runs `npx tsx scripts/codemaps/generate.ts`, and that path does not exist in this repository — there is no codemap generator and no docs/CODEMAPS tree. Ignore that line; build a codemap by reading the tree and write it. The neighbouring `npx madge` and `npx jsdoc2md` are external packages npx fetches, not workspace dependencies, so both need network. The real in-repo generators are `node scripts/generate-sync-manifest.mjs` (never hand-edit its output) and `node scripts/gen-claim-inventory-md.mjs` (`--check` fails on drift).

Drives and repairs browser end-to-end specs, and nothing outside that suite. LOCAL CORRECTION (2026-09-02) to the vendored definition, which is byte-identical to third_party/everything-claude-code/agents/e2e-runner.md and must NOT be edited: its Playwright fallback block runs `npx playwright test tests/auth.spec.ts`, and this repository has no tests/ specs at all. The suite is scripts/src/e2e/*.spec.ts (10 files). Run all of it with `pnpm run test:e2e`; run one file with `pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:e2e src/e2e/review-console.spec.ts` — the spec path is relative to scripts/, because that is the package the script runs in. Verified 2026-09-02: that command with --list enumerates 10 tests in review-console.spec.ts.
Writes failing tests before implementation. Bounded to tests/ so it cannot make an assertion pass by changing the code under test.
Behaviour-preserving cleanup of the decision fabric only.
Resolves build and type failures in the server and web artifacts.

Owns every gate and proof harness in scripts/ (317 files, the largest unowned surface in the tree). Falsifies both directions before claiming a gate works, self-tests every gate, derives scope instead of hand-listing it, and registers in preflight AND CI. Hired 2026-08-23 by the DR-016 loop: most open build-plan rows live in scripts/ and no Tier-2 agent could write there.

Reads the ~3,900 lines of decision core that compute every verdict and have no named reader in review-coverage.json, and reports: dead computed fields, unexercised branches, unfailable assertions, and any path where unknown evidence could loosen rather than tighten the answer. Reports only, never fixes. Hired 2026-08-23 by the DR-016 loop to close build-plan row 42.

Audits ONE property estate-wide: when the code does not know, does the answer tighten or loosen? Hunts fail-open inversions (NaN comparisons, guards that short-circuit on unknown, empty collections concluding no-objection, absent evidence read as good evidence, catch arms minting their own success) and the same defect on a slower clock — figures, cited paths and exemptions that have drifted from what they describe. Hired 2026-08-23 after seven instances of one NaN fail-open were found live on the authentication path, none of which any existing reviewer's lens asked about. Reports with a reproduction and the SHAPE of the gate that would hold the finding; gate-and-proof-engineer builds it. Writes nothing, so it collides with no one.

The org's own executable definition: the skills, agents and commands every other role runs through. WRITES only .claude/. Its review surface is wider than its write surface — .agents/, artifacts/mcp-server/, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md are READ and REPORTED, never written, because artifacts/ already belongs to build-error-resolver and the two instruction files are read by every role at once.
